The '''Imperial Holding Faciliy''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility that was located on the upper levels of [[Camp Conquest]], a military base built into a crater in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Run by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], it held civilians captured under [[executive order 228]], but was destroyed by [[Zenith]] after the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] rescued the prisoners.
